verdicts.reason: A keeps the product on its circle, but the can sticks out past the top of the circle and nearly touches the canvas top. GLACIER now sits below the headline, so the brand is out of order and as big as a second headline. The CTA has shrunk to a chip the same size as the two badges, and the copy and button row are crammed against the bottom edge. B breaks the design: the teal circle is left as an empty disc on the left and the can is cut off from it and pushed to the far right, so the main image is split into two meaningless pieces. B also keeps every flaw of A: GLACIER below the headline and a tiny CTA that is no more prominent than the badges.
